name: borderless
description: Borderless — shop the world, in English. DubHacks 2026.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && tsc -b client
